status: OPEN: answer once; defaults are proposals, not decisions

items.question: Maharaj's apparent age: the Granth says only 'in the prime of youth' (74); 'about 30' is a web figure.
Maharaj's hair, beard and skin tone are not stated anywhere.
items.proposed_default: Short cropped dark hair, clean-shaven, warm medium-brown skin (as in your M1_young_ref / set_v1).

items.question: The old bandi (88) with otherwise digambar (92): your set_v1 Maharaj has a loincloth and no bandi.
items.proposed_default: Show the worn grey-white open bandi plus a minimal off-white loincloth in every image (direction note: 'throughout').

items.question: Bankatlal's look (none stated).
items.proposed_default: Your set_v1 colours: cream turban, sage-green angarkha, white dhoti, uparna, about 35; money pouch removed (it is an Adhyay 2 detail).

items.text: Damodarpant costume; must not look like Devidas
items.question: Damodarpant's look (none stated). set_v1 gave him a white cap that reads as a 20th-century 'Gandhi cap' and the same body/costume as Devidas.
items.proposed_default: Terracotta-red pagadi, white angarkha, lean, about 35: clearly different from Devidas.

items.question: Devidas's look and age (none stated; his son is 13-16 by FINAL S5-3).
items.proposed_default: About 45, shaved head with shikha, sacred thread, red tilak, bare-chested with uparna (set_v1 based).

items.text: Devidas's plate: leaf (default) or metal; which dishes
items.question: Devidas's plate (114): the verse says 'patra' (material not stated); your easy script says 'patraval' (leaf plate). Which dishes?
items.proposed_default: Fresh leaf plate; rice, yellow dal, a vegetable, puris, two round sweets.

items.text: time of day / light of the opening
items.question: Time of day of S1-S6 (not stated; the story only reaches noon at 118/123).
items.proposed_default: Clear late-morning light for S1-S6, hard noon for S7-S9.

items.question: Devidas's house (not described; he heads a math).
items.proposed_default: A solid mud-plastered house with clay-tile roof, plinth step and heavy wooden door (as in your set_v1 location).

items.text: well/trough design; kind and number of animals
items.question: Well and trough design; which animals and how many (134 says 'all the animals').
items.proposed_default: Round stone well, long stone trough, two or three humped Deccan cattle.

items.text: posture at the trough during the teaching (seated default)
items.question: How Maharaj drinks at the trough and his posture during the teaching (not stated).
items.proposed_default: Kneels and drinks from cupped hands; sits cross-legged by the trough for the teaching.

items.text: carries the gourd while running (default yes)
items.question: Does he carry the gourd when he runs (144)?
Preset 08 adds a soft backdrop halo; the brief forbids a halo unless the research states it (91 and 111 speak of radiance, as similes).
items.proposed_default: Keep preset 08 but set its halo intensity to 0 (or at most 0.1 as plain backlight) for Maharaj.

items.text: bow type: standing folded-hands bow (default), not prostration
items.question: The silent bow (112): standing namaskar or prostration?
items.proposed_default: Standing, heads bowed, palms joined (prostration would anticipate 143).

items.text: show feast preparation only through objects (no household members)
items.question: Feast preparation (86) and Devidas's son/household: show people?
items.proposed_default: Objects only (hearth, rice, leaf plates); no household members, no guests.
